intelligence_page_tagline: These personalized recommendations update periodically, so check back regularly.
intelligence_generating_body: This usually takes a few seconds. The list below will update when it finishes.
intelligence_severity_important_descript: Worth handling soon. These affect how others see your lists.
intelligence_severity_suggest_descriptio: Optional polish. Apply if you agree, dismiss if not.
intelligence_severity_info_description: Just a heads-up. No action required.
intelligence_dependents_description: Suggestions about lists you manage on someone else's behalf. They behave just like your own.
intelligence_summary_note: Dismissed items stay hidden, even when suggestions refresh, until the items they're about change or you bring one back.
intelligence_empty_body: Nothing left to act on. Check back later, or hit Refresh to look again.
intelligence_filter_empty_title: No suggestions match the current list filter
intelligence_filter_empty_body: Try expanding the filter to see suggestions for more lists.
intelligence_disabled_feature: Suggestions are currently disabled. An admin can turn them on from the admin Intelligence page.
intelligence_disabled_no_provider: No AI provider is configured. An admin needs to add a provider before suggestions can be generated.
intelligence_group_cleanup_description: Items worth a fresh look or removal.
intelligence_card_dismiss_default_descri: Hide this recommendation. We won't show it again unless the underlying items or lists change.
intelligence_bundle_nav_hint: Open the list to bulk-fix in-place.
intelligence_picker_empty: No eligible lists. Create a wishlist first.
intelligence_picker_preview: "{name}" will be marked as your primary list. You can change this later from the list view.
intelligence_edit_not_authorized: You no longer have permission to edit this item.
intelligence_edit_item_gone: That item no longer exists. Refresh suggestions to see the latest.
intelligence_apply_error_rec_not_active: This suggestion is no longer active. Refresh to see the latest.
intelligence_apply_error_cannot_edit: You can't edit that list anymore.
intelligence_apply_error_items_changed: These items have changed since the suggestion was made. Refresh to see the latest.
intelligence_apply_error_items_have_clai: One of these items has a claim now, so we left it alone. Refresh to see the latest.
intelligence_apply_error_invalid_list_ty: That list type can't be set as primary.
intelligence_apply_error_unknown_apply_k: We don't know how to apply that action.
intelligence_apply_error_list_type_disab: That list type isn't enabled on this deployment anymore.
intelligence_apply_error_todo_list_type_: Todo lists can't be converted to or from another type.
intelligence_apply_error_invalid_holiday: That holiday selection is invalid. Refresh to see the latest.
intelligence_apply_error_not_dependent_g: You're not a guardian of that dependent.
intelligence_apply_error_no_change: Nothing to change. The list is already set up that way.
intelligence_apply_error_merge_cluster_m: These lists changed since the suggestion was made. Refresh to see the latest.
intelligence_apply_error_merge_cross_typ: These lists can't be safely merged anymore. Refresh to see the latest.
gift_help_error_not_configured: Gift suggestions are not set up on this site yet.
gift_help_error_child_not_allowed: Gift suggestions are not available on this account.
gift_help_error_budget_exceeded: Gift suggestions are paused for this month.
gift_help_error_rate_limited: That is a lot of requests. Try again in a little while.
gift_help_error_ai_failed: Could not come up with ideas just now. Try again.
gift_help_error_generic: Could not get ideas for this list.
gift_help_thinking_excluding: Leaving out what is already on their list…
gift_help_thinking_writing: Writing up what to look for…
gift_help_thinking_duration: This usually takes under a minute.
gift_help_description_default: New ideas that are not already on their list.
gift_help_privacy_note: Ideas come from an AI model. It is shown what is on {name}’s lists and whether each thing is already claimed, never who claimed it.
gift_help_no_results: No new ideas this time. Try a different budget.
gift_help_footnote: These are ideas to research, not product recommendations: the AI does not know what is in stock or what things cost today. Gift Ideas are private to you. An off-list gift tells other gifters you are giving it; {name} sees it only after the reveal. “They Have It” keeps an idea out of everyone’s future ideas for {name}; a thumbs down only out of yours. {name} never sees either.
gift_help_saved_new_list: Saved to a new private ideas list for {name}
gift_help_add_off_list_failed: Could not add that off-list gift
list_impact_delete_today: {eventTitle} is today and this is the only list set up to auto-reveal on that day. Deleting means gifts won't auto-reveal.
list_impact_delete_tomorrow: {eventTitle} is tomorrow and this is the only list set up to auto-reveal on that day. Deleting means gifts won't auto-reveal.
list_impact_delete_in_days: {eventTitle} is in {count} days and this is the only list set up to auto-reveal on that day. Deleting means gifts won't auto-reveal.
list_impact_archive_today: {eventTitle} is today and this is the only list set up to auto-reveal on that day. Archiving means gifts won't auto-reveal.
list_impact_archive_tomorrow: {eventTitle} is tomorrow and this is the only list set up to auto-reveal on that day. Archiving means gifts won't auto-reveal.
list_impact_archive_in_days: {eventTitle} is in {count} days and this is the only list set up to auto-reveal on that day. Archiving means gifts won't auto-reveal.
list_impact_change_today: {eventTitle} is today. After this change, no list will auto-reveal on that day.
list_impact_change_tomorrow: {eventTitle} is tomorrow. After this change, no list will auto-reveal on that day.
list_impact_change_in_days: {eventTitle} is in {count} days. After this change, no list will auto-reveal on that day.
